# kion_project_line_item (Resource)

Manages a Kion Project Line Item.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_project_line_item" "example" {
  # Optional
  # amount            = 0.0
  # category_id       = 1
  # datecode          = 1
  # description       = "example"
  # funding_source_id = 1
  # payer_id          = 1
  # project_id        = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `amount` (Number) Amount for the project line item in the application.
- `category_id` (Number) Category ID of related Category of the Project Line Item in the application.
- `datecode` (Number) Datecode for the project line item in the application.
- `description` (String) Description for the project line item in the application.
- `funding_source_id` (Number) Funding Source ID of related Funding Source of the Project Line Item in the application.
- `payer_id` (Number) Payer ID of related Payer of the Project Line Item in the application.
- `project_id` (Number) Project ID of the Project Line Item in the application.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Project line item ID.
